Create a plane from a line and global Z

**Panel:** Comma → Plane · **Nickname:** `LnZ`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Line | `L` | Line | Item |  | Line constraint. Plane origin will be at line middlepoint.Plane X-axis will be parallel to line direction. |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Plane | `Pl` | Plane | Item | Plane definition |
